free_text: The decision to recommend biopsy is supported by convergence across all inputs. The PI-RADS 5 finding on the mpMRI is decisive, aligning with the guideline criterion for re-biopsy. This was further supported by the rising PSA trend from 3.4 ng/mL to 5.9 ng/mL and the prior negative biopsy status. The statistical prior also suggested biopsy with high confidence, and the retrieved evidence confirmed the clinical pathway.
